Messages.Author: David Edelstein
Messages.Body:
Can Quentin's power (or a Demonstration) be used during a Bloodhunt?
IIRC, a Bloodhunt is not considered a Political Action and therefore
cards specifying they can be used during a PA don't apply. However, I
could be wrong (and often am)...

--

-David

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <3A354CE3...@amadan.org>,

David Edelstein <ama...@amadan.org> wrote:
> Can Quentin's power (or a Demonstration) be used during a Bloodhunt?

Quentin's power cannot.
A Bloodhunt is called by a Methusaleh not a minion,
so is not a Political Action.

Demonstration cannot be used during a Bloodhunt either.

> IIRC, a Bloodhunt is not considered a Political Action and therefore
> cards specifying they can be used during a PA don't apply.

This part is correct.

Carpe Noctem.
